question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it be default-on, opt-in, or external-only?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible inside the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, persistent index lifecycle, fallback policy, and official config/default surface.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, hybrid search or tested local fusion, explicit defaults, fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave the official plugin vector-only and direct advanced LanceDB hybrid or rerank behavior to external ClawHub packages such as the already-linked memory-lancedb-pro idea.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, query-text propagation, hybrid search or tested local fusion, explicit defaults, fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across memory-lancedb, memory-core hybrid context, and prior review comments on this issue.
